text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The doctor did say to take it easy for a few days, didn't they~...
choice_data_list: Sorry, that was careless of me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No, don't make that face~
I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, thanks for giving me first aid right away~
That made me feel so much better.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You really are amazing, Trainer~.
You're grand champion-level amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so, back to practice!
Let's keep training~!
choice_data_list: Let's treat this as visual training.
If it looks like too much, I'm stopping you.
If it looks too tough, I'll put a stop to it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so, back to practice!
Let's keep training~!
choice_data_list: Let's treat this as visual training.
If it looks like too much, I'm stopping you.
If it looks too tough, I'll put a stop to it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Hrrrm, I see.
Periods like that are important too, aren't they~
choice_data_list: Put what you learned to good use once your legs heal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Alright, I'll do my best to learn by watching~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the doctor gave the all-clear,
I had her stop running and made sure she got plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~!
Let's get right to it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It really is too dangerous to let her run...
I had Hishi Akebono rest thoroughly until her leg healed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Got it~!
Really, though, I'm totally fine~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to tackle the full-course menu
you came up with for me, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's have a buono training session☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while staying mindful of the injury,
she stayed focused and powered through her training!
